purpose: Prove, rather than assume, whether System Master foundational mapping, tracing, ownership and execution semantics are complete under the current architecture authority.
scope: all canonical foundational requirements and capability crosswalk entries including C00-C49 and P00-P15
all first-class and headless capability ownership decisions
all command, query, API, event and error routes
transaction, concurrency, idempotency, cache, invalidation and sync semantics where applicable
authority, privacy, native, human and external dependency boundaries
evidence/provenance, completion, obligation and expectation bindings
failure, retry, timeout, rollback and recovery behavior
tests, benchmarks, static/dynamic checks and failure-injection obligations
build, release, deployment, operations, maintenance and documentation foundation obligations
closure_rule: Foundation 1.0 may be called complete only when every in-scope row is COMPLETE_WITH_EVIDENCE or EXPLICITLY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_WITH_AUTHORITY, and every durable blocker is separately recorded as preventing only the dependent capability rather than silently closing unrelated work.
no_silent_gap_rule: Missing owner, route, contract, canonical writer, authority boundary, failure semantics, evidence target or acceptance target is an ACTIVE_GAP, not completion.
execution_rule: Each ACTIVE_GAP must be assigned to a canonical owner admitted by the current topology and converted into the highest-value safe dependency-valid successor packet. Owners continue after each completion until their dependency-valid ladder is exhausted.
forbidden_claims: do not infer completion from prior planning volume
do not fabricate ownership, authority or evidence
do not treat a stale/absent delegation as an empty valid lane
do not transfer hosted evidence into A-01/native/private/publication/production authority
do not assign new Foundation 1.0 obligations to terminally retired PROSE
do not split Website Building C40 from PROGRAMMING into a peer system
final_artifact: A 100-percent disposition matrix plus unresolved-gap successor register grouped by current owner with evidence state, dependency state, executable closure gate and Foundation 1.0 closure decision.
